t: The Fortress Trade 1.5" Angled Sash Paint Brush is designed for professional decorators and DIY enthusiasts requiring precision and control. Featuring synthetic bristles and solid, round tapered filaments, this brush excels at cutting-in around windows, doors, and intricate mouldings, ensuring clean lines and a smooth finish. It is suitable for all paint types and varnishes, offering superb paint load capability and significantly reduced tramlines for a flawless application. The comfortable beavertail handle provides excellent grip during extended use, and the brush is quick and easy to clean, saving valuable time on site. This durable painting tool delivers consistent, high-quality results for every decorating project.
